Question Choices: What is a unit square? (A) A rectangle that is 10 units long and 5 units wide (B) A square that is 1 unit long and 1 unit wide
Hints: An area unit is a square with a named length unit on each side.
Solution: Choose B. A unit square is 1 unit by 1 unit and has area 1 square unit.

Question Choices: Select. A shape is covered by 15 unit squares. What is its area? ~~1-square-units | 15-square-units | 20-square-units~~
Hints: Count equal-size squares covering the surface without gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Fifteen unit squares cover 15 square units.

Question Choices: What is a square meter? (A) A square that is 10 meter by 10 meter (B) A square that is 1 meter by 1 meter : A B
Hints: An area unit is a square with a named length unit on each side.
Solution: Choose B. A square metre is the area of a square 1 metre by 1 metre.

Question Choices: Select. If a shape is covered by 20 square meters, what is its area?: ~~5-square-meters | 20-square-meters | 10-square-meters~~
Hints: Count equal-size squares covering the surface without gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Twenty one-square-metre tiles cover 20 square metres.

Question Choices: Select. How many square centimeters make 1 square decimeter?: ~~100-square-centimeters | 50-square-centimeters | 10-square-centimeters~~
Hints: Use 10 centimetres along each side of a square decimetre, so its area is 10 times 10 square centimetres.
Solution: 1 decimetre = 10 centimetres. A 1 dm by 1 dm square is 10 cm by 10 cm, with area 10 x 10 = 100 square centimetres.
